text:
The evidence is inconclusive, leaning against confirming loss. Hansen mapped about 0.7 ha of tree-cover loss in 2020 (0.02% of the 3,643.5 ha property). The independent JRC 2020 reference classes that area as non-forest, so it agrees on 0% of it, short of the 50% needed. The claim is therefore marked "contradicted."

This does not prove that no loss occurred. Hansen also shows another 1.3 ha of loss in patches under 0.5 ha, which are not counted as events. The 2021 national map places the 0.7 ha mostly in planted pine (0.4 ha), with 0.3 ha outside mapped forest and none in native forest.

The data cannot say whether this was deforestation, land-use change or, for example, a plantation harvest, nor what caused it. Any loss here is very small relative to the property.
